Biological Width and the Platform Switching Concept

Many patients considering dental implants often wonder about the long-term success and stability of their treatment. One concern frequently discussed during consultations relates to how implants integrate with the surrounding gum tissue and bone structure. Understanding the concept of biological width and platform switching can help patients appreciate the sophisticated approach modern dentistry takes to ensure optimal implant outcomes.

Why We Assess 'Bone Quality' Rather Than Just 'Bone Quantity'

Many patients considering dental implants often hear about the importance of having "enough bone" to support their treatment. This leads to understandable concern about whether they have sufficient bone volume for successful implant placement.
